build_rag_model: build a RAGModel that initializes Llama 3 8B Instruct with vLLM and a sentence transformer for embeddings
extract_chunks_parallel: extract text chunks from HTML search results in parallel using Ray and the ChunkExtractor class
generate_batch_answers: generate answers for a batch of queries using retrieval-augmented generation with the batch_generate_answer method
calculate_sentence_embeddings: calculate normalized sentence embeddings for a list of text using the calculate_embeddings method
format_chat_prompts: format queries with retrieved references into chat template prompts using the format_prompts method
